name: case_001_sql_injection
description: PR introduces a SQL injection by string-concatenating user input into a query. The reviewer MUST flag this as a critical security issue and request changes.

pr.title: Add user lookup endpoint
pr.description: Adds GET /users/lookup?email=... so the support tool can find users by email.

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,28 @@ from .db import db
 class UserHandler:
     def __init__(self, conn):
         self.conn = conn
+
+    async def lookup_by_email(self, request):
+        email = request.query.get("email", "")
+        # Build query with the provided email so support can search
+        query = "SELECT id, email, status FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'"
+        cur = self.conn.cursor()
+        cur.execute(query)
+        row = cur.fetchone()
+        if not row:
+            return {"found": False}
+        return {"found": True, "id": row[0], "email": row[1], "status": row[2]}
